author: François Terrier
attribution: Photo: François Terrier, CC BY 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:2011-09-17_Nyagatare_Street_Art_01.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Hand-painted shop front in Nyagatare with painted barber/photographer scenes. Lower wall repeats 'NFB'S Photo Express NFB'S'. The left panel lists services ('Dealers in FILMS Selling, PHOTO Printings, DIGITAL Photos, Phone Charging, VIDEO Camera, MTN & TIGO Cards, TWAKIRA Film Zihana gurwa.') and is not part of the target.

author: François Terrier
attribution: Photo: François Terrier, CC BY 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:2011-09-17_Nyagatare_Street_Art_03.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Hand-painted name on both faces of a corner building in Nyagatare; lines follow the right-hand face. 'NYAGATARE' in yellow and 'Butcher' in red script with no space between them. Kinyarwanda: 'DUKORA KUVA Sa' (we open from ...), 'INKOKO' (chicken), 'IHENE' (goat), each beside a painted animal/meat picture.

author: Adam Jones, Ph.D.
attribution: Photo: Adam Jones, Ph.D., CC BY-SA 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Sign_at_Gate_of_Hotel_des_Mille_Collines_-_a.k.a._Hotel_Rwanda_-_Kigali_-_Rwanda.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Floodlit white wall panel at the gate in Kigali, photographed at dusk; small-caps serif lettering under a three-peak logo. Uneven lighting (warm spot in the middle, blue cast elsewhere). The sign has no accent on 'HOTEL'.
source_title: File:Sign at Gate of Hotel des Mille Collines - a.k.a. Hotel Rwanda - Kigali - Rwanda.jpg

author: Adam Jones, Ph.D.

License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Large white shadowed serif capitals painted on a curved metal gate arch near Muhanga; 'HOSPITAL' follows the curve downward. Old colonial brick building behind.

author: Adam Jones, Ph.D.
attribution: Photo: Adam Jones, Ph.D., CC BY-SA 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Mosque_with_Africa_Muslims_Agency_Sign_-_Huye-Butare_-_Southern_Rwanda.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Hand-painted mosque board on two posts above the green mosque wall, Huye (Butare). 'AL-MASIDJID Q'UBAH' is a romanised Arabic name (Quba Mosque) spelled as on the sign, with a straight apostrophe. Two small hand-painted Arabic lines (the basmala at top and the agency's Arabic name at bottom right) are not transcribed because they are too small to read character by character.
source_title: File:Mosque with Africa Muslims Agency Sign - Huye-Butare - Southern Rwanda.jpg

author: UWIMPUHWE Va
attribution: Photo: UWIMPUHWE Va, CC0 1.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Five_to_Five_hotel_at_the_gate.jpg. License: http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/deed.en. Unmodified original.
notes: White-and-green pylon sign at the hotel gate in Remera, Kigali; '5/5 HOTEL' is italic logo text on a globe under palm trees. The phone, email and website lines on the green lower half are left out.

author: UWIMPUHWE Va

notes: Grey board with orange lettering and a right arrow behind a red-and-white railing, Taba, Huye. 'ACCOMODATION' is the sign's spelling. The e-mail line at the bottom is hidden by the railing and left out; a Madonna medallion at top left.
source_title: File:Hotel Mater Boni Consilii at the gate.jpg

author: BalukuBrian
attribution: Photo: BalukuBrian, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Kigali_Genocide_Memorial_entrance_sign_post.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Blue-and-white entrance board above a stone retaining wall, shot upward at an angle; diagonal arrow after 'ENTRANCE'. The smaller facilities list and visiting hours below are partly hidden by a palm frond and left out.
